about_the_game:
Featuring banger upon banger, the music of Mars Attracts takes inspiration from pulpy sci-fi movies and rock anthems. The game's soundtrack gives otherworldly vibes to gameplay, while also incorporating elements of mischief and darkness to reflect the Martian's sinister demeanor.

This soundtrack also includes cover tracks composed and performed for the game's trailers, including the iconic "House of the Rising Sun" (featuring vocals from Liam Brick), and "In the Hall of the Mountain King".
